title: Crimson Academia
case_summary: Professor Ramesh Iyer was found stabbed in the Delhi University library at 20:00. The library was locked from the inside. He was a ruthless academic who stole his students' research and had affairs with colleagues' wives.

victim.name: Professor Ramesh Iyer
victim.background: A genius scholar with a god complex who ruined the careers of anyone who challenged him.
victim_relationships: Kabir (Student): Iyer stole Kabir's groundbreaking thesis.
Anjali (Librarian): Iyer was blackmailing her over a past affair.
Dinesh (Colleague): Iyer had an affair with Dinesh's wife.
Lakshmi (Wife): Iyer was abusive and she wanted his life insurance.

solution.logical_rule: Kabir's alibi fails when the bloody dagger and the thesis papers are found.

suspects.name: Kabir Bose
suspects.alibi: Claims he was in the dorm.
suspects.relationships: You hate Iyer. You are jealous of Anjali.

suspects.name: Anjali Menon
suspects.alibi: Claims she was in the basement.
suspects.relationships: You are terrified of Iyer. You think Kabir is a genius.

suspects.name: Dr. Dinesh Varma
suspects.alibi: Claims he was in his lab.
suspects.relationships: You want Iyer dead. You don't trust Kabir.

suspects.name: Lakshmi Iyer
suspects.relationships: You despise your husband. You pity Dinesh.

evidence.name: Bloody Dagger
evidence.description: Ceremonial dagger from the history department.

evidence.name: Stolen Thesis
evidence.description: Thesis papers with Kabir's name crossed out.
